prototype_disclaimer: Experimental research prototype only. It does not replace Avalanche Canada guidance or field assessment. Scores are relative indices, not probabilities.

release_density_evidence.distribution_choice: Equal density over the paper's 200-250 kg m-3 band is a transparent project choice; the paper does not report this as an empirical uniform distribution.

source.measurement_method: Cylindrical samples cut at the crown across the entire slab layer and weighed in situ.
source.source_population: 30 dry slab avalanche fracture-zone investigations at Whistler Mountain
source.title: Snow-Slab Studies at Whistler Mountain, British Columbia, Canada

transfer_limitations: Whistler measurements are not event-specific measurements for Norway or Svalbard.
The source sample is biased toward older, deeper dry slabs.
No quantitative geographic or event-regime transfer error is available.
The prior cannot compensate for missing release-thickness evidence.
